enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed on the right side. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the left side. Tuck the left arm under the pillow. Straighten the legs. Turn onto the back. Place both arms on top of the blanket. Turn head to the right. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Bend both knees. Stretch the left leg out. Turn onto the back again. Reach out with the right hand and pull the blanket up over the shoulder. Turn head to the left. Remain still under the blanket. Adjust the pillow under the head with the left hand.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Put both feet on the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Extend the right hand to the wall and press the light switch. Turn on the tap with the left hand. Bend forward over the sink. Cup both hands and scoop water. Splash water on the face. Straighten up. Pick up the soap with the right hand. Rub the soap between both hands. Put the soap back on the dish. Rub both hands together. Rinse both hands under the tap. Pick up the towel from the rack with the left hand. Wipe the face with the towel. Wipe both hands with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Turn off the tap with the right hand. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup with the right hand. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles with the left hand. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Put the toothbrush back into the cup. Turn off the light switch with the right hand. Walk to the door. Pull the door open. Step out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door with the right hand. Take a shirt off the hanger with both hands. Lay the shirt on the bed. Pull a pair of trousers off the rail. Lay the trousers on the bed. Open the drawer with the left hand. Pick up a pair of socks from the drawer. Close the drawer with the left hand. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Pull on the left sock. Pull on the right sock. Stand up. Pull on the trousers. Fasten the waistband button. Pull up the zipper. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt from top to bottom. Tuck the shirt into the trousers. Walk to the bed and pick up the phone with the right hand. Press the phone screen to check the time. Put the phone into the trouser pocket. Walk over to the fan and press the switch to turn it off.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say 'Good morning' to Member 2. Open the refrigerator door with the right hand. Take out the milk carton with the left hand. Place the milk carton on the counter. Take out the eggs with the right hand. Place the eggs on the counter. Close the refrigerator door with the left hand. Open the cupboard door. Take out two bowls with both hands. Place the bowls on the counter. Take out the cereal box. Open the cereal box. Pour cereal into the first bowl. Pour cereal into the second bowl. Pick up the milk carton and pour milk into the first bowl. Pour milk into the second bowl. Pick up the kettle and fill it with water at the sink. Place the kettle on the base. Press the switch to start the kettle. Pick up a spoon from the drawer. Place the spoon in the first bowl. Pick up a second spoon and place it in the second bowl. Slide the first bowl across the counter to Member 2. Sit down at the table. Pick up the spoon with the right hand. Scoop cereal and eat. Repeat scooping and eating. Pick up the bowl with both hands and drink the milk. Put the bowl back on the table. Pick up the kettle and pour hot water into a mug. Pick up the mug and take a sip. Stand up. Pick up the empty bowls with both hands. Carry the bowls to the sink.

Walk into the bedroom. Pick up the backpack from the floor with the left hand. Place the backpack on the bed. Unzip the front pocket with the right hand. Pick up the phone from the bed and place it into the pocket of the backpack. Pick up the keys and drop them into the side pocket. Pick up the laptop from the desk with both hands and slide it into the main compartment. Pick up the charger and put it into the main compartment. Close the zipper with the right hand. Pick up the backpack with both hands and lift it onto the back. Adjust both shoulder straps with both hands. Walk to the mirror. Turn around once. Walk to the door. Press the light switch with the right hand.

Walk out of the front door. Pull the door closed with the right hand. Lock the door with the key. Put the keys into the pocket. Walk down the stairs. Push the building entrance door open with the left hand. Step outside. Walk along the sidewalk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the backpack pocket with the right hand. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Take the transit card out of the pocket with the right hand. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Grasp the overhead handrail with the right hand. Stand holding the rail. Take the phone out with the left hand. Scroll the phone screen with the thumb. Press the phone screen and put the phone back into the pocket. Pull the stop request cord with the right hand. Walk to the front door of the bus. Step off the bus onto the sidewalk. Walk along the street to the office building. Push the glass door open with the right hand. Step into the lobby. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator call button with the left hand. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button with the right hand. Step out of the elevator and walk to the office door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at the nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the office. Sit down at the desk. Put the backpack on the floor. Take the laptop out of the backpack with both hands. Place the laptop on the desk. Open the laptop lid with the right hand. Press the power button. Type the password on the keyboard. Move the mouse with the right hand. Click on the email application. Scroll through the inbox with the mouse wheel. Open an email. Type a reply on the keyboard. Press the send button with the right hand. Pick up the phone with the left hand. Dial a partner organization. Speak on the phone about the program schedule. Place the phone down on the desk. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed documents with both hands. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Pick up a pen with the right hand. Write notes on the document margin. Open the spreadsheet on the laptop. Type attendee numbers into cells. Press the save icon with the right hand. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the table. Open the notebook with the left hand. Turn pages with the right hand. Speak with colleagues about the upcoming event. Take notes with the pen. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open a new document. Type the event agenda. Print the agenda. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the pages with both hands. Staple the pages with the stapler. Place the pages into a folder. Sit down at the desk. Close the laptop lid with the right hand. Pack the laptop into the backpack.

Stand up from the chair. Push the chair in with the right hand. Lift the backpack onto both shoulders. Walk to the office door. Push the door open with the left hand. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator call button with the right hand. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk through the lobby. Push the glass door open with the left hand. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Take the phone out with the right hand. Check the bus arrival time on the phone screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader with the right hand. Walk down the aisle. Grasp the handrail with the left hand. Stand holding the rail. Pull the stop request cord with the right hand. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Walk up the stairs of the building. Take the keys out of the pocket with the right hand. Unlock the front door. Push the door open with the left hand. Step inside. Close the door with the right hand. Take off both shoes. Place the shoes on the rack. Walk to the bedroom to put the backpack down.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say 'Hi' to Member 2. Open the refrigerator door with the right hand. Take out the vegetables with the left hand. Place the vegetables on the counter. Take out the meat package with the right hand. Place the meat on the counter. Close the refrigerator door with the left hand. Pick up the knife from the block with the right hand. Pick up a tomato with the left hand. Place the tomato on the cutting board. Cut the tomato into slices with the knife. Slide the slices to the side of the board. Pick up an onion with the left hand. Peel the onion with both hands. Cut the onion with the knife. Place the cut onion into a bowl. Turn on the induction cooker with the right hand. Pour oil into the pan. Pick up the bowl and tip the onion into the pan. Stir the onion with a spatula held in the right hand. Pick up the meat with the left hand and place it into the pan. Stir the meat with the spatula. Add the tomato slices with the left hand. Shake salt over the pan with the right hand. Press the induction cooker switch to turn it off. Pick up two plates from the cupboard with both hands. Place the plates on the counter. Spoon the food onto the plates with the spatula. Carry both plates to the table with both hands. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork with the right hand. Pick up food and eat. Take a sip of water from the glass with the left hand. Continue eating with the fork. Stand up. Pick up the plates with both hands.

Carry the plates to the sink with both hands. Place the plates in the sink. Pick up the sponge with the right hand. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge with the left hand. Scrub the first plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the drying rack with the left hand. Scrub the second plate. Rinse the second plate. Place it in the drying rack. Pick up the forks with the right hand. Scrub the forks with the sponge. Rinse the forks. Place the forks in the drying rack. Wipe the counter with the cloth in the right hand. Turn off the tap with the left hand. Say 'Done' to Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using personal computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the TV remote from the table with the right hand. Press the power button on the remote. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Press the channel button on the remote with the thumb. Place the remote on the sofa arm. Pick up the personal computer from the coffee table with both hands. Open the lid with the right hand. Place the computer on the lap. Type on the keyboard with both hands. Move the cursor with the right hand on the touchpad. Click on a video and watch. Pick up the phone with the left hand from the sofa. Swipe the phone screen with the thumb. Put the phone down on the cushion. Continue typing on the keyboard. Press the space bar with the right thumb. Scroll the trackpad with the right hand. Reach for the glass of water on the table with the right hand. Take a sip. Place the glass back on the table. Adjust the sitting position. Cross the left leg over the right. Press the volume button on the remote. Stand up. Walk to the light switch and press it. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Close the computer lid with both hands. Place the computer on the coffee table. Pick up the remote and change the channel with the thumb.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and chatting with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on the sofa next to Member 2. Say 'How was your afternoon?' to Member 2. Listen to Member 2's reply. Pick up the TV remote with the right hand. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the sofa arm. Turn head toward Member 2 and keep talking. Nod the head. Point at the TV screen with the right hand. Pick up the glass of water with the right hand. Take a sip. Place the glass on the table. Lean back against the cushion. Cross both arms over the chest. Turn head toward the TV. Laugh and say 'That part is funny.' Pick up the phone from the cushion with the left hand. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone down. Adjust the cushion behind the back with both hands. Turn toward Member 2 and continue the conversation. Press the volume up button on the remote with the right thumb.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open with the right hand. Step inside. Press the light switch with the left hand. Press the water heater switch. Open the shower door with the right hand. Turn the tap handle to the left with the right hand. Place the right hand under the water to test the temperature. Adjust the tap handle with the right hand. Step into the shower. Stand under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle with the left hand. Squeeze shampoo into the right palm. Put the bottle back on the shelf. Rub both hands together. Apply the shampoo to the hair with both hands. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap with the right hand. Rub the soap over the arms. Rub the soap over the chest. Put the soap back on the dish. Rinse the body under the water. Pick up the towel from the hook with the right hand. Turn off the tap with the right hand. Step out of the shower. Wipe the hair with the towel. Wipe the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush and squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth. Put the toothbrush back into the cup. Press the dehumidifier switch with the left hand. Press the light switch with the left hand. Pull the door open and walk out.

Walk into the bedroom. Pull back the blanket with both hands. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Pick up the book from the nightstand with the right hand. Open the book to the bookmark. Lean back against the pillow. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Continue reading. Turn the page again. Close the book with both hands. Place the book on the nightstand. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Reach out with the left hand and press the lamp switch to turn off the light.

Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Tuck the left hand under the pillow. Bend both knees slightly. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the back. Straighten both arms on top of the blanket. Turn the head to the left. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up over the shoulder with the right hand. Remain still. Turn onto the back again. Remain still under the blanket.
